caption: The drawing features three views of a double-pronged object rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige background. In the top section, there is a flat, outline sketch showing the symmetric, elongated shape with pointed ends and decorative internal cutouts that form abstract patterns. Below this, a horizontal line drawing illustrates a side view of the object with a central extension that drops downward. A small scale indicating measurements from 0 to 4 inches is also present beneath it. The lower right portion of the drawing contains a shaded, perspective rendering, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance and emphasizing its contours, curves, and surface texture. The illustration includes the artist’s name, "Salvatore Borazzo," written in the bottom left corner.
title: Bootjack
